moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins on Friday, August 21, with reigning champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Football is back! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday. Who's ready for another season of drama?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry
angles.copy: Arsenal start their title defence at home against Coventry City this Friday! Can the Gunners get off to a winning start?

moments.title: Community Shield Final
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 English domestic football season's curtain-raiser, the Community Shield, sees champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Man City face off on August 16 at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: National Preview
angles.copy: It's the traditional curtain-raiser! Arsenal v Man City in the Community Shield this Sunday. Who's taking home the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Cardiff Venue
angles.copy: Big football in Cardiff this weekend! The Community Shield clash between Arsenal and Man City is at the Principality Stadium on Sunday. Who's heading to the capital?

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd continues his 'After Hours Til Dawn' Stadium Tour with multiple dates at London's Wembley Stadium this week, including August 14, 15, 16, 18, and 19.

angles.name: Concert Buzz
angles.copy: London is feeling the 'Blinding Lights' as The Weeknd continues his massive Wembley run this week! Who's going to one of the shows?

angles.name: Wembley Experience
angles.copy: Five nights of The Weeknd at Wembley! If you're heading to the After Hours Til Dawn tour, remember to check stadium info for timings and cashless payments.

moments.title: Madonna's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday on August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Pop Tribute
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Madonna this Sunday! Which of her iconic hits is your all-time favourite?

angles.name: Era Spanning Icon
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue' and beyond – Madonna's influence is undeniable. Wishing the Queen of Pop a very happy 68th birthday on August 16th!

moments.title: Dua Lipa's 31st Birthday
moments.blurb: British-Albanian singer and global superstar Dua Lipa turns 31 on August 22, 2026.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to send some birthday love! Dua Lipa turns 31 this Saturday. What's your top track from the 'Future Nostalgia' star?

angles.name: Celebrating Success
angles.copy: From 'New Rules' to global icon, Dua Lipa has redefined pop. Wishing her a fantastic 31st birthday on August 22nd!
